in_sanskrit.name: वलय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वल्यम् (valyam) - strength, power आ (a) - towards ि (i) - this Therefore, Balai means 'towards strength', 'towards power', or 'towards virility' in Sanskrit.

in_hindi.name: बलाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: बाल (bal) - child, young आई (ai) - mother Therefore, Balai can be interpreted as 'child of strength', 'mother of power', or 'mother of tapas (penance)' in Hindi.

in_marathi.name: Balai
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Balai is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'strength' or 'power'. This name is associated with the god Vishnu, who embodies strength, protection, and preservation. Balai is a powerful and courageous name, suitable for a boy who will grow up to be a strong and fearless individual.
